races.name: Today's Gate Sponsored By The INPBA Fillies Maiden

runners_data.name: Black Chicken
runners_data.spotlight: Sottsass filly; E38,000 yearling; dam 9.4f winner (RPR 72), sister to 1m4f Group 3 winner Pollara, closely related to useful 1m 2yo winner Engage, out of 6f 2yo/8.5f winning half-sister to Arc winner Solemia; market best guide on debut; fourth of 7 in 7f barrier trial at Naas; was behind Elusive Echo then.

runners_data.name: Quinchy Lady
runners_data.spotlight: Alkumait filly, half-sister to six winners inc Chuck Willis (Listed-placed 5f-1m inc 2yo/US/Canadian dirt; RPR 102), Imaginarium (1m1f Flat, 96; 2m hurdle) and Xebec (1m2f-1m4f; 95); dam 7f winner (inc 2yo/AW; 79); likely best watched on debut unless the market speaks.

runners_data.name: Spring Sprinter
runners_data.spotlight: Elzaam filly; sister to 1m2f-12.4f Flat (RPR 99) and useful 2m-2m2f hurdle winner Smooth Tom, half-sister to 1m6f Flat (89) and useful 1m7f-2m1f hurdle/chase winner Royal Hollow; from a family the trainer knows well and could go well on debut.

runners_data.name: Sweetie Too
runners_data.spotlight: Dawn Approach filly; dam runner-up 6f 2yo (RPR 74), half-sister to winners New Treasure (6f 2yo Group 3) and Regheeb (useful 1m-1m2f), out of 6f 2yo/7f Group 3 winner; a bit of appeal on paper, so check the betting.

runners_data.name: Elusive Echo
runners_data.spotlight: Sea The Stars filly, E48,000 foal; sister to winners Rogue King (1m4f AW, RPR 74; 2m1f hurdle) and Motriff (UAE 9.7f), half-sister to 1m/1m2f winner Evident Beauty (99); dam unraced half-sister to 1m2f-1m4f Group 1 winner The Fugue; first of seven in 7f barrier trial at Naas last week; tongue tied for debut; check the market.

runners_data.name: Glasarmi
runners_data.spotlight: Not a bad effort over 7f (yielding) here on debut, showing up well before weakening into a 12l fifth of 12; not sure this longer trip will suit on that evidence.

runners_data.name: Amenita
runners_data.spotlight: Kingman filly didn't show much in sole start last season at Cork (7f, soft) when slowly away; pedigree suggests she'll get better with age and she's open to plenty of improvement on her seasonal reappearance.

runners_data.name: Ballerina Dancer
runners_data.spotlight: Massive odds and has failed to beat a rival in maidens at Leopardstown and Limerick; look elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Kirkland Sioux
runners_data.spotlight: Sioux Nation filly has failed to make an impact in maidens at Leopardstown (1m, good) and when 66-1 at Dundalk on latest (7f); others preferred.

runners_data.name: Star Of Beauty
runners_data.spotlight: 0-6 and rated 74; some solid efforts in defeat, including a 0.5l third of 13 in a Naas maiden last August (6f, good); shaped like worth another go at 1m when a keeping on second in a 7f claimer at Roscommon latest; player.

runners_data.name: Flagstone Lady
runners_data.spotlight: Soundly beaten at long odds in maidens at Cork and over C&D; will qualify for handicaps after this.

races.name: KCLR 96FM Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Pinball Wizard
runners_data.note: Prominent runner lacking recent form after 206-day absence but proven class on dangerous low mark
runners_data.spotlight: A winner of six races when trained in Britain but failed to hit the frame for this stable last season; on a dangerous mark but lacks a run and likely best watched.

runners_data.name: Queen Aethelflaed
runners_data.note: Hold-up type with strong C&D form who fades in finish but won off similar mark at Thurles
runners_data.spotlight: Won off 1lb lower at Thurles last October (1m, gd-yld), her last start in this grade; soundly beaten both starts this term but could revive back in 0-60 company.

runners_data.name: Royal County Glory
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who scored at Dundalk recently, drops 2lb and shortening in trip from 7f failure
runners_data.spotlight: Scored off 3lb lower at Dundalk (7f) on penultimate; came up short on return to turf when a 3l fifth off revised mark at Fairyhouse (7f, good); eased 2lb and worth a go at 1m on that evidence; place shout.

runners_data.name: Brains
runners_data.note: Lone front runner in good form lately, gets uncontested lead but faces wall of closers at age 10
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran has shaped very nicely the last twice at Leopardstown (7f, yld-sft) and Roscommon (7.5f, good); close third off 3lb higher over C&D last summer; big chance with the step back up to 1m sure to suit.

runners_data.name: Medieval Night
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades in finish, regressive form since good debut handicap effort
runners_data.spotlight: Placed on handicap debut for Dermot Weld last August off 6lb higher but regressive form since; beaten 21l over 1m6f here latest; drops in trip; hard to fancy on recent form; cheekpieces tried.

runners_data.name: Rock Etoile
runners_data.note: Prominent type who fades in finish, no revival signs despite big handicap drop from peak rating
runners_data.spotlight: Last turf win came over C&D in September 2024 off 18lb higher; finished last year in poor form, however, and no signs of a revival in two runs this term.

runners_data.name: Tynamite
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran who is 0-33 on turf despite AW success, 139-day absence concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Veteran is a six-time AW winner but 0-33 on turf; no success since December 2023 and never involved on seasonal return at Killarney 20 days ago; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Chou Chou
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner returning from 139-day break after poor hurdles effort, needs to bounce back
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last year over slightly further than this at Tipperary (gd-fm) and Clonmel (soft); remains 3lb above that last success and tailed off over hurdles at Killarney 23 days ago.

runners_data.name: Believeth
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades in finish, weak on handicap debut suggests 5lb drop insufficient
runners_data.spotlight: Didn't show much in maidens at 6f-1m on the AW and on good to firm ground; weakened out of it on handicap debut at Leopardstown (1m, gd-yld); 5lb drop not enough to tempt; tongue tie applied.

runners_data.name: Gold Dublooms
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who fades but showed good C&D form in May, 9lb lower than that third-place effort
runners_data.spotlight: Ran well when a 5.5l third over C&D (good) on handicap debut last May and 9lb lower now; off since 10l defeat at Dundalk in January; a repeat of that C&D run last season would give him a squeak.

runners_data.name: Heart Of Darkness
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, 0-10 on turf record despite AW success
runners_data.spotlight: AW winner is 0-10 on turf and yet to trouble the judge; best efforts on grass have come on heavy ground, so the forecast rain is a plus, but others appeal more.

runners_data.name: Balance Of Trade
runners_data.note: Hold-up type suited by soft/heavy ground, good recent C&D claimer form in similar conditions
runners_data.spotlight: 0-10; best form on soft and heavy ground; ran well in C&D claimer last month (soft) and again in a Bellewstown handicap (1m, soft) on penultimate but poor on quicker ground at Ballinrobe latest; rain would boost chance.

runners_data.name: Half Nutz
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with six wins but losing run stretches back to September 2022
runners_data.spotlight: Six wins but losing run stretches back to September 2022; not terrible efforts over C&D the last twice, but needs to find more to get his head back in front.

runners_data.name: Hale Bopp
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with decent recent C&D third, 2-33 turf record but showed life latest
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner; 2-33 on turf but hasn't won a race of any description since September 2023; decent third over C&D latest, however, and place claims if he can back that up.

runners_data.name: Monastere
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who fades in finish, no winning potential shown yet but Karl Thornton yard firing
runners_data.spotlight: No sign of winning potential in maidens or in first two handicaps; yard in hot form though and still early days, so worth monitoring in the market.

runners_data.name: Real Petite
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who fades in finish, tailed off over longer trip at Leopardstown on return
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose maiden; tailed off when last of 19 on return to the Flat at Leopardstown over 1m5f; big drop in trip now; impossible to fancy.

races.paceDynamic: Brains is the sole committed front runner and will set a sustainable gallop without pressure through the early stages. The prominent runners Royal County Glory and Pinball Wizard will track just behind, while the large contingent of hold-up horses including Queen Aethelflaed, Hale Bopp, and Gold Dublooms will settle at the rear. With one unchallenged leader and a patient field, this sets up a moderate pace that will quicken late as the hold-up brigade launches their challenges. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fastest and prominent racers positioned to strike, while the lone leader Brains faces a wall of closers in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays moderate and the field remains compact turning for home...
scenarios.body: The large group of hold-up horses will have maximum opportunity to unleash their finishing kicks simultaneously. Horses like Queen Aethelflaed and Gold Dublooms who showed strong C&D form will benefit most from this patient tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Royal County Glory and Pinball Wizard press forward approaching the turn...
scenarios.body: They can steal a march on the hold-up brigade while Brains weakens, creating the perfect scenario for horses racing in second or third. The moderate early pace will leave them with enough petrol to resist the late charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Brains Holds Gamely
scenarios.trigger: If the veteran leader maintains his rhythm and the closers come too late...
scenarios.body: His recent good form at Leopardstown and Roscommon suggests he can sustain his effort better than usual. The uncontested lead gives him every chance to repel challenges in the final furlong despite his age.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Brains goes very slowly and nobody wants to challenge early...
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint from the two-furlong pole, suiting any horse with a sharp turn of foot regardless of rating. This chaotic finish could produce a surprise winner from the lower-rated contingent.

watchPoints.text: Brains could get an armchair ride in front with no pace pressure but faces a cavalry charge of closers
Queen Aethelflaed's tendency to fade in finishes clashes with her strong course form and low weight
Royal County Glory shortening in trip after Fairyhouse failure could be the key tactical switch needed
Multiple horses carry "fades in finish" warnings which could prove decisive in a slowly-run race
Gold Dublooms returning from 143-day break but drops 9lb from her good course third in May

races.name: Sonix Entertainment Handicap

runners_data.name: Just Keep Flying
runners_data.note: Front runner with proven stamina but 194 days off the track could blunt his early speed
runners_data.spotlight: Won a Goodwood maiden (1m2f, gd-fm) on debut for the Gosdens; creditable efforts on turf and AW in three subsequent starts; bought for 20,000gns in December; overlooked by Foley, so probably best watched after break on stable bow.

runners_data.name: Stellar Quality
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist perfectly suited to expected strong pace, trainer in excellent form
runners_data.spotlight: Bellewstown maiden winner on second start last August (12.5f, good); modest effort on seasonal return in six-runner Killarney race; the form of that Bellewstown race has worked out and she could go well on handicap debut; preferred by Foley.

runners_data.name: Not Just Any Eagle
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who struggled on soft ground last time but returns to preferred conditions
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner; last scored at Leopardstown in May 2025 off 4lb lower; struggled on soft ground on seasonal return over 1m6f here in April; might need another run or two to hit top form.

runners_data.name: Navinsky
runners_data.note: Prominent style but disappointing seasonal return suggests he may need this run
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in one of four starts in maidens, at Navan last September (1m2f) when a neck runner up; well below that level on seasonal return in Ballinrobe maiden; steps up in trip for handicap debut; check the market.

runners_data.name: Satono Chevalier
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in excellent current form with back-to-back wins for new connections
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time winner is 3-14 on turf; has notched up back-to-back wins at Navan (1m2f, heavy) and on debut for this yard at Ballinrobe (1m5f, gd-yld); has gone up 14lb but has won off 2lb higher on the AW, so still on a feasible mark.

runners_data.name: Flying Fortress
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who has won off similar mark but modest seasonal return is concerning
runners_data.spotlight: Ground-versatile sort won a Ballinrobe maiden (9.5f, good) and a Listowel handicap (8.5f, heavy) last season off 1lb lower; modest effort on seasonal return at Ballinrobe (9.5f, gd-yld) but sharper for that and can't be discounted with yard in form.

runners_data.name: Daboya
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who shaped well last time and races off fair mark
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose; just 1lb higher than when winning a Curragh handicap last season (1m4f, good); shaped with promise when a 5l fifth of 14 at Roscommon latest and has gone well here before; interesting but wouldn't want to see much rain.

runners_data.name: Pavilion End
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but poor recent form and quick return from disappointing Curragh run
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose AW winner; out of form at Dundalk earlier this year and disappointing return to turf at the Curragh eight days ago; eased 1lb and down in trip, but others arrive in better fettle.

runners_data.name: Voice Of Reason
runners_data.note: Prominent runner better on artificial surfaces, hasn't won on turf since 2023
runners_data.spotlight: Dual-purpose; 1-9 on turf on the Flat; won on the AW (1m4f) off 4lb lower in January and has generally held form well since; hasn't won on turf since 2023, however, and others make more appeal.

runners_data.name: Derry Lad
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade in finish, first reserve adds uncertainty
runners_data.spotlight: First reserve; goes on any ground but on losing run since a Pontefract win in June 2023; well treated on that form and not disgraced when a rallying 7.25l fifth at Leopardstown latest (1m4f); place shout if backs that up.

runners_data.name: Beauparc
runners_data.note: Prominent runner and course winner but underwhelming return to turf last time
runners_data.spotlight: Won this last year off 3lb lower; in good form on AW earlier this year but underwhelming return to turf when beaten 7l at Sligo (10.5f, yld-sft) on latest; return to 1m4f a plus and Colin Keane takes over; should go well.

runners_data.name: Inthesmallhours
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who has struggled in first two turf handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Dundalk maiden winner in December; has beaten just one rival home in first two turf handicaps at Sligo (10.5f, soft) and Leopardstown (1m2f, good); yard going well but she's hard to fancy on those last two efforts.

runners_data.name: Sir Callisto
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in good AW form but unproven on turf in handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: In fine form over 1m4f on the AW since return from a break; won off 72 in early April and close second off revised mark later that month; raised another 3lb for that but can't be discounted on return to turf (won on good ground in France).

runners_data.name: Justenzia
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who was runner-up here last time over shorter trip
runners_data.spotlight: Sole win off 16lb lower at Clonmel last September (9.5f, soft); runner up both starts this term, including here over 9.5f (soft); 2l behind Satono Chevalier at Ballinrobe on latest (1m5f, gd-yld); 4lb better off now and could turn the tables; forecast rain a plus.

runners_data.name: Spanish Rising
runners_data.note: Front runner on handicap debut but soundly beaten at the Curragh last time
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a 1m2f Ripon maiden (good) for former yard; soundly beaten on debut for this stable at the Curragh (1m, heavy); worth a market check on handicap debut, though rain would be a concern.

runners_data.name: Tatum
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with excellent course record but second reserve status
runners_data.spotlight: Second reserve; enjoyed an excellent campaign last season which included two wins at Leopardstown (1m4f, good and 1m5f, good); 1m2f too sharp on return there latest and could do better now stepped back up in trip.

runners_data.name: Obscenity
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse in fine current form but raised 12lb after recent Navan win
runners_data.spotlight: In fine form this season; third on seasonal return at Bellewstown (11.5f, soft); won by 5.5l at Navan (1m2f, gd-yld); hiked up 12lb but again ran well when a 2.75l runner up at Roscommon latest (1m4f, yielding) when not getting the clearest of runs; in the mix again off 1lb higher.

runners_data.name: Bobby Kirova
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with tendency to fade, third reserve after two poor handicap efforts
runners_data.spotlight: Third reserve; mild promise in maidens but has bombed out in first two handicap starts here (9.5f, soft) and at Roscommon (1m4f, good); eased 4lb but others preferred.

runners_data.name: Cala Bonita
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 187-day break with stamina to prove
runners_data.spotlight: Won back-to-back races at Dundalk last autumn (both 10.5f); also won a 1m handicap here last season (good) off 14lb lower; off since November and stamina to prove for this trip, so probably best watched.

races.paceDynamic: Just Keep Flying and Spanish Rising will contest the early lead, with both confirmed front runners likely to engage from the start. Not Just Any Eagle, Navinsky and several prominent runners will track close behind, creating an honest gallop over this testing 1m4f trip. The pace should be genuine but not suicidal, with the large field spreading out behind the leaders. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as the early pace battle will set up a strong finish for those with tactical speed.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuine between Just Keep Flying and Spanish Rising
scenarios.body: The leaders will come back to the field in the final furlong, allowing patient hold-up horses to sweep past with superior finishing kicks. Stellar Quality, Satono Chevalier and Obscenity are perfectly positioned to capitalise on this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Wins
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is more moderate than expected with one leader dominating
scenarios.body: Horses tracking in second or third position can strike from two furlongs out without relying on a sustained finish. Not Just Any Eagle and Beauparc have the tactical pace to exploit this scenario from their prominent positions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Just Keep Flying gets an uncontested lead with Spanish Rising disappointing
scenarios.body: The pace becomes more controlled, allowing the leader to maintain momentum and hold off late challengers. Just Keep Flying has the proven stamina for this distance and could repeat his Goodwood success.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners go too fast early and tie up dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the back with the entire field converging in the final two furlongs. This chaos scenario could produce a surprise winner from the hold-up brigade at longer odds.

watchPoints.text: Just Keep Flying and Spanish Rising could go too fast early if both are keen, creating pace collapse
Satono Chevalier has rapidly improving form but headgear change with inexperienced jockey adds risk
Stellar Quality from the in-form Harrington yard could benefit most from expected strong early gallop
Not Just Any Eagle needs to handle return to good ground after struggling on soft last time
Obscenity carries big weight rise after recent win but has shown consistent improvement this season

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap

runners_data.name: Akecheta
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who needs strong pace to be effective; Colin Keane aboard but faces tactical disadvantage if tempo stays modest
runners_data.spotlight: Gained second heavy-ground win in a conditions race at this venue (7f) last September; yet to win a handicap; well supported in three of her four races this term, including the Irish Lincoln; has not run to expectations; new headgear combination tried.

runners_data.name: Pink Oxalis
runners_data.note: Classy hold-up mare with course-winning form; 40 days off and relies on others to create gallop for her late kick
runners_data.spotlight: Four wins last year, including over 1m at this track on soft in April; career-best when landing a very competitive fillies' handicap at Leopardstown last September; not in the same form on first two starts this year; slowly away over 7f here last time, staying-on third was a decent effort in the circumstances.

runners_data.name: Tachos
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with course-and-distance winning form; Chris Hayes knows her well and Weld stable in good form
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner in 2024; added another over 1m1f at Leopardstown last June; ran creditably when fifth behind today's rival Pink Oxalis at Leopardstown last September; out of her depth in a Listed race at Dundalk on final start last season.

runners_data.name: Ob La Di
runners_data.note: Versatile prominent runner who won over 1m2f last August; 5lb claimer McGettigan takes pressure off at these weights
runners_data.spotlight: Won over an extended 1m2f at Naas last August on good ground; not suited by heavy ground on her final two starts; in rear on soft on return; much better when fourth at Leopardstown, 1 3/4l in front of favourite Akecheta.

runners_data.name: River Ara
runners_data.note: Three-year-old with front-running ability shown in nursery win; could surprise if Wayne Lordan sends her forward early
runners_data.spotlight: Made all in back-end 1m nursery at Leopardstown (yielding to soft); unable to land a blow in 7f Guineas Trial at same venue last month, but finished not far off some useful types; sights lowered now after a Listed run at Naas; cheekpieces fitted; sole filly of her age in this race.

runners_data.name: Thrifty Of Digby
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner returning to course where she won; Shane Foley perfect partner for controlling tactics
runners_data.spotlight: Two wins last year, including over 1m at this venue; two moderate runs this term, including in a Sligo race in which Chico Guerrera was second, before returning to form with a winning display at Roscommon a fortnight ago; made all over the extended 7f then, this trip is within her range; 5lb extra does not seem harsh.

runners_data.name: Spanish Temptress
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who showed promise when second at Limerick in April; needs others to set up the race
runners_data.spotlight: Went up an aggregate 21lb for three handicap wins last season; seemed to be improving when second at Limerick in April, beaten only a nose; Curragh run eight days ago (17th of 19) was too bad to be true; 7-2 chance then, interesting to see if the market is prepared to overlook that showing.

runners_data.name: Chica Guerrera
runners_data.note: Handy racer who stays well; 7lb claimer Holohan reduces her burden and Mark Fahey stable hits winners when ready
runners_data.spotlight: Tramore 1m4f winner last August and finished the season well with placed efforts in big fields on heavy ground at the Curragh; Sligo second early last month was on very soft ground; prominent all the way before fading into fourth over 1m2f on good ground at Leopardstown last time.

races.paceDynamic: Thrifty Of Digby will take the field along from the front with no other confirmed pace-setters in this eight-runner contest. The Jessica Harrington mare should get uncontested fractions early, allowing her to dictate terms through the middle stages over this 1m1½f trip. With prominent runners like Tachos and Chica Guerrera likely tracking behind, and a strong contingent of hold-up horses including Pink Oxalis, Akecheta, River Ara and Spanish Temptress, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace could become pedestrian. This race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can position close to the pace, as the lack of early pressure will make it difficult for hold-up horses to close from off the tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Thrifty Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Thrifty Of Digby gets soft fractions and isn't pressured early
scenarios.body: Shane Foley can dictate ideal splits and kick clear turning for home before the closers get organized. The hold-up horses will have too much ground to make up from the steady gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Tachos and Chica Guerrera track Thrifty closely and apply pressure from 3f out
scenarios.body: The pace quickens enough to set up the race for horses positioned handy, but not so much that it completely suits the back-markers. Chris Hayes gets first run on Tachos who has course form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes crawling and the field bunches turning for home
scenarios.body: Pink Oxalis and Akecheta get the perfect scenario with a sprint finish where class tells. The race becomes a dash where the highest-rated horses with finishing kicks can unleash.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: River Ara Makes All
scenarios.trigger: If River Ara breaks quickly and disputes the lead with Thrifty Of Digby
scenarios.body: The Ballydoyle filly shows her nursery-winning front-running ability and creates genuine pace that suits her style. Wayne Lordan gets aggressive tactics that catch rivals off-guard.

watchPoints.text: Thrifty Of Digby's early fractions will determine the entire race shape - if she gets easy splits the hold-up horses are in trouble
River Ara could completely change the complexion if Wayne Lordan sends her forward to dispute or make the running
Pink Oxalis needs to be positioned closer than usual given the lack of pace - watch Jack Kearney's positioning choice
Tachos must track the pace closely as her best form comes when prominent rather than held up
The 7lb and 5lb claiming allowances for Chica Guerrera and Ob La Di could prove decisive in a tight finish

races.name: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Gowran Classic (Smullen Series)

runners_data.name: Hardy Warrior
runners_data.note: Front-runner with highest rating who should dominate early pace but 50 days since last run
runners_data.spotlight: Took second behind Derby candidate Benvenuto Cellini in the four-runner Futurity Stakes at the Curragh last August; fourth to Puerto Rico in Group 1 at Saint-Cloud in October; won a three-runner 1m conditions event at Naas on reappearance; did not quite see out the extended 1m2f when third in the Prix Noailles at Longchamp; heads the stable's strong challenge.

runners_data.name: Why Wyoming
runners_data.note: Non-runner
runners_data.spotlight: Non-runner

runners_data.name: Mo Mhuirin
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making step up in class after Dundalk maiden win
runners_data.spotlight: Long-priced winner of a 1m maiden at Dundalk last December; satisfactory run at Killarney on turf/seasonal debut; tough task in this company

runners_data.name: Satoyama
runners_data.note: Hold-up type who won at this course and ran yesterday at Listowel
runners_data.comment: Prominent throughout over 1m at Gowran when readily beating a subsequent winner
runners_data.spotlight: Maiden winner over 1m at this venue on his second start; unable to reward market support at Listowel yesterday, but ran with credit in fourth.

runners_data.name: Bunyola Bay
runners_data.note: Front-runner making seasonal debut after 38-day break
runners_data.spotlight: Finished third of eight, beaten 3l, when the well-backed favourite for a soft-ground maiden at Newbury last October (winner finished fourth in the Greenham); made all for 7f Doncaster win on seasonal debut; should stay and could be progressive

runners_data.name: Killashee Warrior
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed good form behind True Love at Leopardstown
runners_data.spotlight: Thurles maiden winner last October after a fine effort in a 7f Listed race at Leopardstown; made a very pleasing start to the season when fourth behind True Love in a Group 3 event at Leopardstown; not quite as promising in the same category at the Curragh last time; fair prospects of reaching the money.

races.paceDynamic: Hardy Warrior, Bunyola Bay and Honouramongthieves will ensure a strong gallop from the start in this competitive field of 20. The presence of three confirmed front-runners guarantees genuine pace throughout the 1m1½f trip, with Hardy Warrior likely to dominate early given his class advantage. This sustained gallop will test stamina reserves and set up the race for closers. The strong pace clearly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers with tactical speed over those needing to race prominently from the start.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Class
scenarios.trigger: If Hardy Warrior and Bunyola Bay engage in early battle
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will expose the lesser lights and allow the highest-rated horses with stamina to assert late. Class tells as the pace collapses in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go too fast early
scenarios.body: The strong pace will perfectly set up horses held up off the early speed to deliver late challenges. Patient rides on the best stayers will be rewarded.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets soft sectionals
scenarios.body: Hardy Warrior or Bunyola Bay could dictate terms if they avoid early pressure and maintain a strong kick. The field may leave it too late to catch the leader.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners go off conservatively
scenarios.body: A slowly-run race would favour prominent racers who can quicken rather than pure stayers. The race becomes more about speed than stamina.

races.paceDynamic: Private Larry and Jewels Legacy are both front runners but both carry fade-in-finish warnings and lack recent form sharpness, suggesting they'll create early tempo but won't sustain. With 14 runners over 1m1½f on good ground, the pace should be honest but not breakneck early. The large field means hold-up horses will need luck in running, while the suspect stamina of the pace-setters creates opportunities for those racing prominently behind them. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the early pace and outstay the leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Private Larry and Jewels Legacy set honest early fractions before fading in the straight
scenarios.body: The early leaders will weaken approaching the final furlong, allowing horses positioned prominently to inherit the lead and hold off late challengers. Accelereight and Onyeisi are best positioned to capitalise from their forward-running styles.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Finds Clear Run
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and the field comes back to the closers
scenarios.body: A slow early gallop followed by a sprint finish will suit horses with turn of foot held up in rear. Pliny's class advantage becomes decisive if he gets a clear run through the packed field.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Favours Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If Private Larry shows improved stamina and maintains a strong gallop throughout
scenarios.body: The front runner's new headgear and gelding operation help him stay the trip better than expected. This sustained tempo will find out horses lacking stamina over the extended distance.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Messy Finish
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters fade early leaving no clear leader in the straight
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical affair with multiple horses hitting the front in the final two furlongs. This scrappy finish could suit any horse getting the right run at the right time.

watchPoints.text: Private Larry and Jewels Legacy both show early speed but have proven stamina limitations over this trip
Pliny needs a clear passage through the 14-runner field to utilise his superior class from the rear
Accelereight is perfectly positioned to inherit the lead if positioned prominently behind the early pace
Sweet Baby Zou ran just 3 days ago which could provide fitness edge or indicate desperation from connections
Onyeisi represents Karl Thornton stable in good current form and showed ability on all-weather surfaces

races.paceDynamic: Zitkala Sa, A Pretty Penny, and Borora Aura will ensure a strong early gallop over this stamina-testing trip, with Canon Law potentially adding to the pace pressure. The genuine speed up front will stretch the field and create a searching test of stamina in the final three furlongs. With 11 of 15 runners adopting hold-up tactics, traffic problems are inevitable as they funnel into the straight seeking racing room. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with proven stamina who can avoid the scrimmaging, while the abundance of hold-up horses will compromise each other's chances.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Suits Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If the four front runners maintain a genuine pace throughout
scenarios.body: The relentless gallop will expose stamina limitations and favor horses who can stay the trip strongly. Hold-up horses will struggle to make up ground against the testing pace.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders tire dramatically in the final furlong
scenarios.body: A Pretty Penny or one of the prominent racers will inherit the lead as the pace setters fade. Late-running hold-up horses will find opportunities if they can secure clear runs.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Problems Decide
scenarios.trigger: If the large field of hold-up horses creates significant interference
scenarios.body: Prominently-raced horses with clear runs will capitalize while better-fancied rivals get blocked behind the pace. The race will be won by position rather than pure ability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If A Pretty Penny or Zitkala Sa find improved form and sustain their gallop
scenarios.body: The winner will be one of the pace-setters who proves too honest for the field to catch. The strong early pace will set up perfectly for a front-running performance.

watchPoints.text: A Pretty Penny's position early will be crucial - if she settles off the pace rather than leading, the race dynamic changes completely
Traffic problems are almost certain with 11 hold-up horses in a 15-runner field - draw and early positioning will be vital
Zitkala Sa and Borora Aura both need to prove their stamina at this trip while setting a strong pace
Wedding Year's Dundalk form transferring to turf could make her dangerous at a big price
Amrum's quick reappearance after improved run on Friday could signal significant progress
